r1-obs_1.question: Check logs and error metrics for mobile-gateway, account/balance services, and KYC service integration between 12:30 and 13:15 on 2026-09-21, specifically filtering for US customer requests.

finding.summary: In the 12:30 to 13:15 window on 2026-09-21, mobile-gateway in region us-east experienced a sharp rise in 5xx error rates for accounts (accounts_5xx_ratio reaching ~0.61-0.66 starting around 12:40), corresponding to log evidence of connection refusals when calling the upstream accounts service in us-east.

claims.text: Between 12:30 and 13:15 on 2026-09-21, the mobile-gateway service reported elevated accounts_5xx_ratio in region us-east, rising from 0.08 at 12:30 to 0.61 at 12:40, 0.66 at 12:50, and 0.64 at 13:00.
At 12:39 on 2026-09-21, mobile-gateway logged a WARN message: 'upstream accounts connection refused region=us-east'.
The 5xx errors affecting US customers on mobile-gateway starting around 12:40 coincide with connection refusals from the upstream accounts service in the us-east region.

hypotheses.statement: An unrecorded configuration change or network policy update in us-east blocked mobile-gateway from connecting to accounts.
assumptions: An unrecorded infra/configuration change or deployment occurred around 12:40 causing accounts service in us-east to go down

report.summary: The investigation into account summary errors for US customers remains inconclusive due to low confidence across all hypotheses and missing log telemetry. Primary hypotheses include file descriptor exhaustion in the accounts service (H1), resource exhaustion driven by downstream KYC vendor latency (H2), and unlogged software or configuration updates in us-east (H3). Further evidence is needed to confirm the root cause.
